verdict.rationale: The Codex CLI runs locally on your own machine, installs via npm, and has a public GitHub repo. A community comment contrasts the CLI with the closed-source desktop app, which implies the CLI's source is open. However, the CLI still requires signing in with a ChatGPT plan or an OpenAI API key, so the models stay OpenAI-hosted, and the cloud agent (Codex Web) is only offered as a hosted service. Missing for 10: self-hostable model/inference backend, self-hosted deployment of the cloud/web task environment, explicit documentation of running without OpenAI-hosted services.
